annotations.text:
CREDOM site redesign — what this canvas is

Four pages (Home, About, Services, Contact), each at desktop 1440 and phone 390, plus the open mobile menu.

Direction: white-dominant editorial. The theme, page set and section order follow decisions already made in the repo's merge history (PRs #1–#10): predominantly white surfaces with the multi-colour card system; the Home hero is the single dark surface, chosen by the owner from the first canvas. What is new is the typographic scale and rhythm from Pelumi's 8 September draft — oversized Rokkitt display type, numbered hairline lists, gold accent words — plus her newer copy where it does not reintroduce anything that was removed on purpose.

UI/UX Pro Max (uupm.cc) rules applied for a marketing agency: storytelling page order, bold expressive type, brand colours as section colours, case study kept visible on Home, 44px+ tap targets, labels above every field.

Small copy fixes made against the draft: 'drive deep' → 'dive deep', 'Branding experience design' → 'Brand experience design', and a duplicated 'every element' removed from Deliver.

Deliberately NOT reintroduced (removed earlier by Pelumi's direction)

• Fetuga S.O. / Project Manager profile — removed in PR #4. The About team section stays a single feature for the Business Lead / COO.
• 'Meet the Force' eyebrow and 'The people behind the moments.' headline — removed in PR #6. The role eyebrow ('Meet the Business Lead / COO') opens the section.
• Closing 'Schedule a Chat' bands on About and Services — removed in PR #6. Only Home keeps one.
• Footer nav links, logo, tagline and address — removed in PR #6 (tagline first in Aug). Footer stays one row: copyright plus mail and Instagram icons.
• Midea Pro Shop and Terra case studies — replaced by AltDrive 'Future in Motion' and removed in PR #9. Only the AltDrive card appears; no Work page.
• Careers section and nav link — removed in PR #3.
• Street address — removed in Aug; only 'Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria'.
• Large dark surfaces — re-themed white in PR #1. Exception, by the owner's call on 10 Sept: the Home hero uses the dark design from the first canvas; every other surface stays light.

Pelumi's 8 Sept draft contains all of these, so worth confirming with her whether any should come back.

Home — BUILT (branch claude/site-design-mobile-views)

• Hero is the dark version from the first canvas, kept on the owner's instruction: ink ground, the 'Attention Is Earned' photo fading in from the right, the draft's headline as the H1 ('they remember.' in gold), Schedule a Chat + Explore Services, scroll cue. The one dark surface on the site.
• 'Attention Is Earned. Experience Makes It Last.' becomes the cream intro chapter under it.
• 'Most Marketing Is Ignored' gets a faint CREDOM watermark and 128px type.
• 4D1M is a numbered hairline list under 'From Insight To Impact.' with the draft's fuller step copy; Measure stays the gold row.
• 'What we've done' keeps the single AltDrive card and the logo rail, exactly as shipped after PR #9.

Mobile: the photo is a 300px band above the headline; buttons go full width; process rows stack; logos stack one per row.

About

'Bold. Strategic. Immersive.' is staggered and sticky beside the four intro paragraphs from Pelumi's draft. The belief quote gets a paper-2 band at 58px italic. Vision (teal) and Mission (gold) carry the draft's headline statements. 'Why choose us?' stays white with the headline at display scale and the draft's four paragraphs plus the italic gold line. Values become a bento grid (2-2-2 / 3-3). The team section is the single COO feature from PR #4/#6, with the draft's three-paragraph bio.

Services

Same six colour blocks as today, now with the full capability lists from Pelumi's draft (seven items each for Corporate Events and Digital). New: a numbered jump index under the intro so visitors go straight to a service. No closing CTA band, per PR #6.

Contact

White hero with the draft's 'Let's Make MAGIC.' headline and a faint watermark. The form keeps today's five fields; submit still goes to FormBold. The sidebar keeps Email and Location and adds the phone number from the draft (+234 807 777 2827) — the one new contact detail. Mobile: single column, full-width button, 52px inputs.

Behaviour to build (not visible in static frames)

• Nav is sticky on paper with blur; active page underlined in gold. Mobile drawer as shipped in PR #8: Escape and route change close it.
• Reveals are not drawn in the frames. One reveal only: sections fade and rise 12px on first scroll into view, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. No opacity gating that can get stuck (a past bug).
• Form: inline errors under fields, focus moves to the first error, success panel replaces the form.
• 'Read more' on the case card can open a detail page or expand in place; decide once the AltDrive photo arrives.
